channel.title: Days Since Ohio Crash
channel.description: Tracking every incident where a car has driven into a building in the Columbus, Ohio metro area. Sourced. Verified. Satirical. Currently: 112 day(s) since last incident.

item.title: Stolen car crashed into Dublin Donatos after attempted traffic stop
item.description: Stolen car crashed into Dublin Donatos after attempted traffic stop — The driver stole a car, fled police, and chose a Donatos as their final destination. Bold pizza order. | Donatos Pizza, Dublin OH | via NBC4 WCMH-TV

item.title: Columbus restaurant donating food to pantries after car crashes into building
item.description: Columbus restaurant donating food to pantries after car crashes into building — Survived a car crash. Still made sure the community ate. Honestly more functional than most of us after a crisis. | Columbus restaurant (undisclosed), Columbus OH | via NBC4 WCMH-TV

item.title: Mezcla closes after car crashes into building
item.description: Mezcla closes after car crashes into building — A beloved Short North restaurant. Closed by a car, not by critics. The car left no Yelp review. | Mezcla Restaurant, N High St, Columbus OH | via Columbus Underground

item.title: Kids as young as 8 steal car, flee police, crash into home
item.description: Kids as young as 8 steal car, flee police, crash into home — Eight years old. Stole a car. Fled police. Crashed into a house. Ohio's youngest urban planner. | Residential home, Columbus OH | via Google News / Local

item.title: Gahanna salon remains open despite car crashing into building
item.description: Gahanna salon remains open despite car crashing into building — The car came in without an appointment. They still finished the blowouts. Professionals. | Gahanna salon, Gahanna OH | via 614NOW

item.title: Car crashes into building near Ohio State, injuring three people
item.description: Car crashes into building near Ohio State, injuring three people — Three injured near Ohio State. The building was not on the syllabus. The driver did not pass. | Building near Ohio State campus, Columbus OH | via WSYX ABC6

item.title: Another car crashed into a Columbus building — police say it's part of a growing trend
item.description: Another car crashed into a Columbus building — police say it's part of a growing trend — Police have officially classified this as a 'trend.' item.description: FedEx truck plows into home in Westerville — The package was delivered. Into the living room. Two-day shipping, one-second entry. | Residential home, Westerville OH | via WSYX ABC6

item.description: Char Bar to reopen 7 months after car crashed into it on High Street — Seven months of repairs. The car took seconds. The bar took a season. Columbus giveth and Columbus taketh. | Char Bar, High St, Columbus OH | via Columbus Dispatch

item.description: East Columbus day care sustains damage after car crashes through wall — A car crashed through the wall of a day care. The children, mercifully, were uninjured. The wall was not. | East Columbus day care, Columbus OH | via WBNS 10TV

item.description: Reynoldsburg O'Charley's reopens quickly after car plowed into it — Back open fast. A car hit it and it shrugged. Respect the Reynoldsburg grit. | O'Charley's Restaurant, Reynoldsburg OH | via NBC4 WCMH-TV

item.description: Fishburger restaurant in Driving Park damaged after car slams into building — A restaurant called Fishburger in a neighborhood called Driving Park. The car was, in retrospect, inevitable. | Fishburger, Driving Park neighborhood, Columbus OH | via Columbus Dispatch
